speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hyaline Membrane Disease (Respiratory Distress Syndrome). The clinical picture of a 33-week preterm infant with onset within hours of birth, grunting, retractions, and a chest X-ray showing a ground-glass appearance is classic for surfactant deficiency. The arterial blood gas confirms respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia.
